text:
The multi-sensory experience described in the evidence is a forest installation that immerses visitors in the Amazon rainforest. This experience engages multiple senses: visually, through high-definition screens displaying lush greenery; auditorily, via speakers emitting rainforest sounds; olfactorily, with mist machines releasing the scent of wet earth and leaves; and tactilely, by walking on soft, uneven materials that mimic the forest floor.

The name of the river that runs through London is the Thames.
